name: Auto Deco
description: One-click themed auto decoration (Hell, Heaven, Water and more) for your level in the editor.

deco-ids.name: Custom Theme Object IDs
deco-ids.description: Used by the "Custom" button. Comma-separated object IDs (e.g. 39,392). Picked randomly.

density.name: Density (%)
density.description: Chance that an exposed block edge gets a decoration.

no-touch.name: No Touch
no-touch.description: Makes placed decorations harmless (recommended, so spikes etc. do not kill you).

max-objects.name: Max Objects Per Run
max-objects.description: Safety cap so huge levels don't freeze the editor.

recolor-scene.name: Recolor Background & Ground
recolor-scene.description: Themes also place color triggers at the start of the level for the background and ground.

random-scale.name: Random Scale
random-scale.description: Themed decorations get a random size for variety.
